discovered_via.method: first-principles buyer-side reasoning, cs search on municipal union membership
queries_used: Svaz měst a obcí ČR seznam členských měst databáze

discovery_basis.why_relevant: Municipalities are the highest-volume contracting authorities in CZ public procurement, including for cash handling, POS/e-payment for local fees and IT. Regional unions publish itemised member lists (SMOJK: 131 members as of Aug 2025); the national SMO ČR site did not surface an open itemised roster, so regional unions plus the RÚIAN/ARES obce registries are the practical route.

source_name: Svaz měst a obcí ČR + regional unions (SMO ČR / SMOJK) – member municipality lists
